help.what: Quick-Start remembers which apps are open and where they sit: workspace, monitor, layout and window sizes. Restore reopens them and puts each one back.
help.limits: It doesn't save tabs, open files or anything inside an app. Apps that restore their own session, like Zed or a browser set to continue where you left off, bring that back themselves. Terminals reopen in their folder.
help.step1: Arrange your desktop, type a name above and press Save.
help.step2: Press Restore to bring it back. Apps that are already open are moved into place, not opened twice.
help.step3: Press Update to replace a session with what's on screen now.
